policy_origin: PF2-selected ownership/storage/PP/command policy; primary source verifies only native pairs and source moves. No complete cartridge/GO-parity claim.

commands.inspect: +necrozma inspect <host slot or full owned UUID>
commands.combine: +necrozma combine <host slot or full owned UUID>=<companion slot or full owned UUID>/<move slot>
commands.separate: +necrozma separate <host slot or full owned UUID>
commands.confirmation: explicit yes/no; server-bound exact terms/character/lifecycle/version; fresh locked commit validation

ownership.host_identity: retain existing owned UUID, owner and current party/box placement
ownership.companion_identity: retain exact owned UUID/owner and freeze saved fields
ownership.companion_placement: new canonical combined state with active NecrozmaCombination link
ownership.active_role_limit: one active link per member across host and companion roles

transaction.service: one owner-validated native-form service; existing PlacementService/PP/move helpers
transaction.existing_writer_rule: never acquire character after already locking storage; reconcile battle start/shared reservation lock graph before activation
transaction.receipts: bind exact request and lifecycle; return historical outcome without resurrecting released sources or undoing newer cycles
transaction.legacy: audit and fail closed; no inferred companions or automatic data repair

separation.originally_boxed: prefer still-valid prior box; allocate new legal position

resources.health: current host absolute HP deficit via normal stat helpers; fainted0/conscious>=1; preserve current status/sleep
resources.host_progression: retain own EXP/level/EVs/friendship/Hyper Training/flags/held item; no partner rewards
resources.source_slot: selected actual1..4 including empty; bind active moveset, save only displaced slot identity/current PP
resources.form_move_bank: per host/source, survives separated cycles; first legitimate introduction base PP5 once; preserve zero/boost history thereafter
resources.slot_edits: lock mutating active/saved moveset/teach/learn/forget operations while linked; reads and non-slot base knowledge/EXP remain valid
resources.restore: remove temporary source learned/slot exposure; persist bank; restore only displaced slot or empty gap; preserve other current PP/progression

battle.unfused_native_signature_identity: preserve existing native profile/fingerprint and queued/used checkpoints
battle.z_exception: only exact target/crystal/source with live pair proof; never blanket changesFrom waiver

issues.title: [Items][P3] Add canonical Necrozma pair and companion reservations
issues.scope: Add the data/integrity foundation only; no public combine command, fused Z eligibility or live migration.
acceptance_criteria: Add an active NecrozmaCombination binding this character's storage, distinct host/companion UUIDs, exact base/target pair, lifecycle/version, chosen active-set/slot binding and return hint. Add the canonical combined companion placement, never reuse trainer-Fusion placement or a hidden box.

Define durable per-host/per-source form PP resources and idempotent operation receipts. Live pair foreign keys protect both members; separated-history receipts use retained UUID/outcome data and cannot permanently prevent ordinary later release or resurrect a deleted member.

Enforce exactly one canonical placement, one active membership across either pair role, matching owner/storage/species/form, reciprocal companion/link state, placement NULL shape and synchronized legacy mirrors. Extend the existing PostgreSQL deferred checks and placement audit; no parallel ownership source.

Audit legacy/directly granted fused rows, missing companions, role reuse and inconsistent resource/move state. Fail before migration writes on ambiguous data; never invent, delete or automatically separate sources.

Use isolated production-model PostgreSQL constraint/outer-transaction/upgrade tests, including actual installed deferred checks and invalid bulk-write commits. Preserve existing placement/capture/trainer-Fusion regressions. Migration files may be prepared; execution against a game database requires separate approval.

issues.title: [Items][P3] Enforce Necrozma reservations across conflicting operations
issues.scope: Wire shared fresh eligibility and lock ordering before any player activation; coordinate #722/#723 without implementing their unrelated transfer/Fusion features.
acceptance_criteria: Apply one shared role-aware eligibility hook under fresh locks to both linked members. Companion is inspectable but cannot move, battle, receive field/learning/held-item writes, release, transfer/list, enter Daycare/breeding or trainer-Fusion. Permit only the contract's reviewed host operations.

Reject combining sources referenced by current/unlocked trainer-Fusion state, any conflicting reservation, foreign/same-account-alt owner, egg, unconscious source, stale/partial battle references or invalid placement. Preserve trainer Fusion IDs/forms/fighter EXP unchanged.

Reconcile character→storage→trainer→UUID-ordered sources→placement/link/resources with existing storage-first writers and battle start. An already storage-locked writer must not acquire a later character lock. Make battle-start versus combine a serialized race, not a command-time lock check.

Block directly created/captured owned fused forms without a valid live pair; a static itemUser/form row, copied appearance or unsupported encounter cannot fabricate a second owned source. Retain ordinary native/base captures and NPC encounter behavior; failed capture cannot debit a ball or strand rows.

Expose a compatible reservation boundary for #722 and #723; do not add another owner-transfer writer or re-enable +trade. Guard release, box operations, current field/evolution/move writers and trainer-Fusion paths that exist now, including service-level bypass attempts.

Run independent-connection PostgreSQL races against placement/release/Fusion/field use/battle entry and supported transfer reservations, plus negative ordinary inputs and deferred-integrity checks. Prove legal host use, companion freeze, no deadlock/loss/duplication and unchanged unrelated behavior.

issues.title: [Items][P3] Implement atomic Necrozma combine and separate
issues.scope: Implement the private service for exactly Necrozma+Solgaleo→Dusk-Mane and Necrozma+Lunala→Dawn-Wings. Public registration and fused Z remain gated.
acceptance_criteria: Re-read the caller's current human/Center/battle state and both real owned party/box sources inside the transaction. Keep host UUID/owner/current canonical placement; reserve the unchanged companion with the canonical combined placement. No item/energy/quest cost, source grant, third Pokémon, or trainer-Fusion writer.

Commit form/ability/stat cache updates, companion placement/mirrors, exact active source-slot setup, first-use resource or saved PP restoration, displaced-slot snapshot, live link and operation receipt together. Use reviewed host stats/HP helpers and canonical move/capacity services; companion moves/PP are never copied.

Retain host genetics/nature/nickname/EXP/EVs/friendship/flags/Hyper Training/held item. Preserve current absolute HP deficit, fainted zero and status/sleep state on form changes; never replay an old HP/PP/progression snapshot. Companion fields stay frozen.

Separate even a fainted/statused host; restore base Necrozma on the same row, persist/remove only the bound temporary source exposure and restore its displaced slot, release exactly that companion and remove the active link in the same commit.

Return previous party slot if free, then first free slot, then an owner box; an originally boxed companion prefers its still-valid old box. Handle full parties/deleted hints via PlacementService without eviction/slot compaction; no legal destination means full rollback and retained valid pair.

Bind request UUID/terms/version/lifecycle. Exact retries return committed history without repeating effects; changed partner requires separation; stale separation from an older cycle cannot undo a newer pair or resurrect released rows.

Inject failure after every durable write and outer rollback, checking fresh SQL, shared-instance caches, mirrors, resources, receipts and success silence. Exercise both forms, party/box sources and independent-connection combine/combine, combine/separate and separate/separate contention.

issues.title: [Items][P3] Preserve Necrozma form-move slots and PP across player routes
issues.scope: Integrate the two source-slot/resource bindings with ordinary PP/move/progression writers. Current get_valid_moves only reads level-up entries and returns neither fused form's R-coded source move.
acceptance_criteria: Keep exactly the selected actual active-set slot 1–4, including an empty gap, bound to Sunsteel Strike or Moongeist Beam. Use canonical ActiveMoveslot/MovesetSlot/temporary learned identity; do not edit generated learnsets, copy companion knowledge or expose arbitrary R-coded moves.

Give each host/source resource base PP5 once on first legitimate introduction. Preserve remaining/zero PP across reconnect, separation, changing companions and later cycles. Existing PPCapacity/MovePPBoost remain authoritative; missing/conflicting prior-use data must fail closed rather than reinitialize.

Commit actual attack/Z PP debit and active resource history together. Integrate field/battle Ether/Elixir/Leppa, healing, PP Up/Max and battle synchronization without double debit, over-capacity, free restore or stale mirror. Dormant form PP and the hidden displaced ordinary move cannot be healed or selected.

Lock active/saved moveset editing/switching, forgetting, mutating teach/learn prompts and source replacement while linked. Preserve read-only views. New base-Necrozma level-up knowledge/EXP may persist, but active-set changes/prompts are deferred; never lose earned progression.

On separation retain the form resource/bonus history, remove only its temporary learned/slot exposure and restore only the displaced original slot/current PP or empty state. Other spent PP, newly earned base knowledge and progression persist; copied runtime moves never overwrite the canonical binding.

Test real ordinary PP/healing/progression commands, zero/boosted PP repeated cycles, parent rollback/faults/concurrency, gapped/empty slots and failed source substitutions with independent SQL. Preserve current Rare Candy/PP items/medicine/learning and native Lunala/Solgaleo source routes.

issues.title: [Items][P3] Add the ordinary Necrozma combine/separate player flow
issues.scope: Implement the proposed +necrozma command classes, inspection and review flow. Keep public mutation registration gated until this issue and the dependent battle/Z acceptance both pass.
acceptance_criteria: Implement read-only discovery and inspect, combine <host>=<companion>/<slot>, and separate <host>; accept canonical gapped party slots or full owned UUIDs for boxed sources, never ambiguous nicknames/account-wide authority. No N-Solarizer/Lunarizer, Ring, plot quest or new currency.

At a fresh Pokémon Center in human form, preview exact source names/UUIDs/placements, selected form/slot and displaced PP, frozen held items, resource policy and companion return policy. Require explicit yes/no confirmation using a server-bound current-terms/lifecycle/version request expiring after5 minutes.

Revalidate all authority, location, battle/placement/reservation and exact terms at commit; stale/duplicate/cancelled/expired/foreign/same-account-alt input changes nothing. Publish one accurate success only after outer commit, with old/new names, retained pair identity and actual return location.

Expose host/companion association, read-only companion status and owned counts in appropriate party/storage/detail surfaces without treating the reserved companion as an actionable party/box member or changing trainer-Fusion labels. Explain source-slot editing limits and no PP refill.

Exercise configured ordinary acquisition of both native base sources, real command/menu confirmation, form inspection, canonical storage moves, field items, reconnect, separation/full-party fallback and restored source rows in disposable PostgreSQL. Keep fixture/staff setup separate from ordinary input.

Provide exact help and current supported/deferred docs, plus positive/negative/rollback/replay transport and fresh SQL evidence for both forms. Do not claim public activation, fused Z, live source availability or deployment from metadata/command tests.

issues.title: [Items][P3] Accept fused Necrozma battles and existing Z signatures
issues.scope: Qualify ordinary battles plus exactly Dawn-Wings/Lunalium/Moongeist Beam and Dusk-Mane/Solganium/Sunsteel Strike through valid live combination provenance; no blanket form whitelist.
acceptance_criteria: Build the host from its unchanged owned UUID, current fused species/stats/types/Prism Armor and canonical source slot/PP. The companion never enters a roster, chooses an action, receives EXP or changes in synchronization. Entry/reconnect/mutation/PP/end-sync validate both owned sources, matching canonical link/reservation and lifecycle/version.

Add only the live-pair-proved changesFrom/native eligibility exception. A raw owned fused row, itemUser tuple, nickname, copied ability/Transform or forged/stale/missing companion proof cannot qualify. No direct fused capture/grant shortcut.

Reuse the existing two200-power signatures, one actual source PP, reusable crystal and side budget, protection/type/nonbreakable-ability rules, prevention, rollback and checkpoint history. Keep existing native Lunala/Solgaleo Z profile identities/fingerprints stable; do not invalidate their earlier queued/used checkpoints.

Preserve combination across switch/faint/revival/reconnect/end/flee/concede; only explicit field separation removes it. Persist host PP/HP/status/progression to the correct row and resource once; preserve every companion field.

Initial combined-host support is ordinary moves/items/flee and those two Z signatures. Reject Mega/Tera/Dynamax/Ultra stacking before queuing in this bounded slice, leaving all existing unfused/native behavior intact. No AI activation/new format/new crystal or Counter expansion.

Run acquire→combine→+hold→ordinary attack and +zmove→meaningful effects/SQL PP/use→switch/rebuild/end→separate/return flows for both forms, with ability/protection/immunity/source-zero/corrupt/current-owner/side-budget/fault controls. Rerun native Lunala/Solgaleo, existing Mega/Tera/Z and item regressions plus full mandatory gate before public mutation activation.

issues.title: [Items][QA] Verify Necrozma lifecycle on an intentionally released build
issues.scope: Prepare and complete integrated acceptance after local gates; select the deliberately released candidate and obtain exact deployment/migration/restart authorization separately.
acceptance_criteria: Publish immutable implementation commits, the two-form native/source/status matrix, complete local ordinary-command/SQL/effect/concurrency/rollback/rebuild/end receipts and mandatory test results. Check the full original contract, including companion freeze, source PP cycles and unchanged native signatures.

Choose a named environment/released SHA and inspect its schema/source state read-only. Prepare exact migration/deployment/reload/stock steps if needed and ask separately for any unapproved operation; this issue is not authorization to execute them.

Use disposable tagged ordinary characters and real base source acquisition, with separate staff preparation/observation and a protected-data baseline. Walk real Center movement, combine confirmation, inspection, battle/source PP/Z, reconnect, field items and separation for both forms, including full-party/boxed return.

Record exact commands, expected/observed results and relevant independent SQL/current proof; distinguish staff/setup, automated transport and ordinary live socket evidence. Do not use a directly granted fused row as native acquisition proof or touch human characters/Pokémon.

Retain failed/unsupported checks, fix through bounded prerequisites, rerun affected gates and complete cleanup of only tagged fixtures. Verify protected rows unchanged and no unresolved pair/reservation/source-resource leftovers.

Mark live/released acceptance only after the actual walkthrough, with operator authorization and cleanup evidence. Keep new forms/Z disabled or explicitly unreleased if prerequisites or release approval remain missing. Ultra, plots, unrelated features and permanent source grants remain out.

activation_gates.release_authorization: separate exact approval for any deployment/migration/restart or game-data setup
